title: Bucs GM Jason Licht: Everything is on the table for a Baker Mayfield contract extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs GM Jason Licht: Everything is on the table for a Baker Mayfield contract extension
sources.description: "I don't have a timeline for that but our plans revolve around Baker in the future, so I don't think anybody wants to see Baker leave the organization," Licht said on PFT Live.
